"""Run inside the workbench's Docker application runner."""
import argparse
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

from ledger import add_expense, list_expenses


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='A small persistent expense ledger')
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest='command', required=True)
    add = commands.add_parser('add')
    add.add_argument('--title', required=True)
    add.add_argument('--cents', required=True, type=int)
    add.add_argument('--category', required=True)
    commands.add_parser('list')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    path = Path(os.environ.get('AGENTFORGE_DATA_DIR', '.')) / 'expenses.json'
    entries = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) if path.exists() else []
    if args.command == 'add':
        entries = add_expense(entries, args.title, args.cents, args.category)
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(json.dumps(entries, ensure_ascii=False), encoding='utf-8')
        result = entries[-1]
    else:
        result = list_expenses(entries)
    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Run inside the workbench's Docker application runner."""
import argparse
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

from ledger import add_expense, list_expenses, summarize_expenses


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='A small persistent expense ledger')
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest='command', required=True)
    add = commands.add_parser('add')
    add.add_argument('--title', required=True)
    add.add_argument('--cents', required=True, type=int)
    add.add_argument('--category', required=True)
    commands.add_parser('list')
    commands.add_parser('report')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    path = Path(os.environ.get('AGENTFORGE_DATA_DIR', '.')) / 'expenses.json'
    entries = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) if path.exists() else []
    if args.command == 'add':
        entries = add_expense(entries, args.title, args.cents, args.category)
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(json.dumps(entries, ensure_ascii=False), encoding='utf-8')
        result = entries[-1]
    elif args.command == 'report':
        result = summarize_expenses(entries)
    else:
        result = list_expenses(entries)
    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

import unittest
from bridge import call

class SummarizeExpensesTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_empty(self):
        self.assertEqual(call('ledger', 'summarize_expenses', []),
                         {'total_cents': 0, 'categories': []})

    def test_single_category(self):
        entries = [
            {'id': 1, 'title': 'a', 'cents': 100, 'category': 'food'},
            {'id': 2, 'title': 'b', 'cents': 250, 'category': 'food'},
        ]
        self.assertEqual(call('ledger', 'summarize_expenses', entries),
                         {'total_cents': 350,
                          'categories': [{'category': 'food', 'total_cents': 350, 'count': 2}]})

    def test_multiple_categories_sorted(self):
        entries = [
            {'id': 1, 'title': 'a', 'cents': 100, 'category': 'transport'},
            {'id': 2, 'title': 'b', 'cents': 200, 'category': 'food'},
            {'id': 3, 'title': 'c', 'cents': 50, 'category': 'food'},
        ]
        self.assertEqual(call('ledger', 'summarize_expenses', entries),
                         {'total_cents': 350,
                          'categories': [
                              {'category': 'food', 'total_cents': 250, 'count': 2},
                              {'category': 'transport', 'total_cents': 100, 'count': 1},
                          ]})

    def test_unicode_order(self):
        entries = [
            {'id': 1, 'title': 'a', 'cents': 10, 'category': 'b'},
            {'id': 2, 'title': 'b', 'cents': 20, 'category': 'A'},
            {'id': 3, 'title': 'c', 'cents': 30, 'category': 'a'},
        ]
        result = call('ledger', 'summarize_expenses', entries)
        self.assertEqual([c['category'] for c in result['categories']], ['A', 'a', 'b'])
        self.assertEqual(result['total_cents'], 60)

    def test_ignores_extra_fields(self):
        entries = [
            {'id': 1, 'title': 'a', 'cents': 100, 'category': 'food', 'note': 'keep'},
            {'id': 2, 'title': 'b', 'cents': 200, 'category': 'food', 'note': 'x'},
        ]
        self.assertEqual(call('ledger', 'summarize_expenses', entries),
                         {'total_cents': 300,
                          'categories': [{'category': 'food', 'total_cents': 300, 'count': 2}]})

    def test_does_not_mutate_input(self):
        entries = [{'id': 1, 'title': 'a', 'cents': 100, 'category': 'food'}]
        call('ledger', 'summarize_expenses', entries)
        self.assertEqual(entries, [{'id': 1, 'title': 'a', 'cents': 100, 'category': 'food'}])

    def test_integer_cents_no_float(self):
        entries = [
            {'id': 1, 'title': 'a', 'cents': 1, 'category': 'x'},
            {'id': 2, 'title': 'b', 'cents': 2, 'category': 'x'},
        ]
        result = call('ledger', 'summarize_expenses', entries)
        self.assertEqual(result['total_cents'], 3)
        self.assertIsInstance(result['total_cents'], int)
        self.assertIsInstance(result['categories'][0]['total_cents'], int)

"""Run inside the workbench's Docker application runner."""
import argparse
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

from ledger import add_expense, list_expenses


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='A small persistent expense ledger')
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest='command', required=True)
    add = commands.add_parser('add')
    add.add_argument('--title', required=True)
    add.add_argument('--cents', required=True, type=int)
    add.add_argument('--category', required=True)
    commands.add_parser('list')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    path = Path(os.environ.get('AGENTFORGE_DATA_DIR', '.')) / 'expenses.json'
    entries = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) if path.exists() else []
    if args.command == 'add':
        entries = add_expense(entries, args.title, args.cents, args.category)
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(json.dumps(entries, ensure_ascii=False), encoding='utf-8')
        result = entries[-1]
    else:
        result = list_expenses(entries)
    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest='command', required=True)
    add = commands.add_parser('add')
    add.add_argument('--title', required=True)
    add.add_argument('--cents', required=True, type=int)
    add.add_argument('--category', required=True)
    commands.add_parser('list')
    commands.add_parser('report')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    path = Path(os.environ.get('AGENTFORGE_DATA_DIR', '.')) / 'expenses.json'
    entries = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) if path.exists() else []
    if args.command == 'add':
        entries = add_expense(entries, args.title, args.cents, args.category)
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(json.dumps(entries, ensure_ascii=False), encoding='utf-8')
        result = entries[-1]
    elif args.command == 'report':
        result = summarize_expenses(entries)
    else:
        result = list_expenses(entries)
    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
